# GrupoFacil

[![Sponsor on GitHub](https://img.shields.io/static/v1?label=Sponsor&message=%E2%9D%A4&logo=GitHub&color=%23fe8e86)](https://github.com/sponsors/bsfraga)

**Find the right players for your group, and join groups faster, in World of Warcraft: Forever.**

The native Looking For Group window lists every player and group with no filters, so you have to scroll through all of them. GrupoFacil opens next to it and lets you filter the list by level, class and role. It also asks a group leader to let you in with one ready-made whisper.

## Features

- **Filters for the Looking For Group list**
  - **Players** (solo listings), **Groups** or **All**.
  - **Level range**, or **Near me** (your level, 3 below to 3 above).
  - **Class**: click the class icons; none selected means all classes.
  - **Role**: tank, healer or DPS, with how many results fit each one. In Groups mode it becomes **Needs**: groups with an open spot for that role, as the game reports it.
  - **Dungeon**: pick one or more dungeons from the current results, each with its suggested level.
  - Hide players and groups that left the list.
  - Sort by level, name or newest.
  - **Compact mode**: hide the filter rows so more of the list fits; the filters keep working.
- **Needs you**: groups with an open spot for a role you marked in Looking For Group are highlighted.
- **Group tooltip**: role, class and level of every member, the open spots, the leader's zone and the dungeon's level range.
- **Friends and guild first**: friends (including Battle.net friends playing Forever) and guild members are marked and listed first.
- **Hide or block**: right-click a row to hide it for this session or block the player for good. Players on your game ignore list are hidden too.
- **Who is this?**: right-click a row to run `/who` on the player (you press Enter); their guild and exact zone then show in the tooltip.
- **One-click actions on each row**
  - **Invite** a solo player (when you are solo or the group leader/assistant).
  - **Ask to join** a group: sends the leader a whisper such as *"Hi, I'm a level 29 Beast Mastery Hunter, can I join your group?"* (only when you are solo).
  - **Whisper**: opens the chat to write your own message.
- **Search again** repeats your last Looking For Group search.
- **Groups for your quests**: a magnifier next to every quest in the objective list and in the quest details. One click searches Looking For Group in the quest's zone and opens the **Quests** tab of the GrupoFacil window (next to the **Dungeons** tab), with the groups doing that quest first. No group? **Create group** lists you in the quest's zone (a dungeon quest lists a dungeon group) with one click, no description needed (the game keeps the description box for the player only: addons can't fill it in or paste into it). Players who also use GrupoFacil see each other's quests silently, the leader invites from the window (or automatically, if they turn it on), and the invite from the leader you asked is accepted by itself. When the quest is done, the addon offers to leave the group and remove the listing.
- **Your own message**: use `{class}`, `{spec}`, `{level}`, `{name}`, `{role}` (your Looking For Group roles) and `{activity}` (the group's dungeon). Your spec is detected from your talents, or you can set it yourself.
- **Six languages**: English, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish (Spain), Spanish (Latin America), German and French. It follows your game client until you pick one in the options (the UI reloads).
- **Resizable window**: drag the bottom-right corner; a taller window shows more rows.
- **Role icons** for tank, healer and DPS in the list and the filters.
- **Minimap button** and an entry in the AddOns menu: left-click opens the window, right-click opens the options.
- **Options** in their own window and in *Options > AddOns > GrupoFacil*.

## Safe by design

WoW: Forever uses the modern add-on security rules (taint and secret values). GrupoFacil follows them:

- It never changes or calls into the Blizzard Looking For Group window. It only reads the search results, so the native window keeps working.
- Searches only run from your click, as the game requires.
- Built-in limits on whispers: one request every 3 seconds, the same leader at most once every 5 minutes, and a request is only marked **Sent** after the game confirms it.
- When the game restricts chat (inside instances), the list freezes and no messages are sent.
- Quest groups never use a chat channel: GrupoFacil users talk through addon whispers only, with a send limit. The magnifier buttons sit on top of the quest tracker and quest log without changing them. Auto-invite is off by default and capped at 6 invites every 10 minutes; auto-accept only takes the invite from the leader you asked, for 2 minutes.

## Usage

1. Open **Looking For Group** and search as usual. GrupoFacil opens next to it.
2. Pick Players or Groups, then filter by level, class and role.
3. Use **Invite**, **Ask to join** or **Whisper** on any row.

The first time the window opens, a banner offers a 30-second tour of the window. You can replay it any time with `/gf tour`.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/gf` | Open or close the window |
| `/gf options` | Open the options |
| `/gf tour` | Show the quick tour of the window again |
| `/gf lang en` / `pt` / `es` / `mx` / `de` / `fr` | Interface language (reloads the UI) |
| `/gf msg` | Show the join request text and how it goes out |
| `/gf msg <text>` | Set your own text (`{class}`, `{spec}`, `{level}`, `{name}`, `{role}`, `{activity}`) |
| `/gf msg default` | Back to the default English text |
| `/gf spec <name>` / `/gf spec auto` | Set or detect your spec (per character) |
| `/gf mode direct` / `/gf mode prefill` | Send the whisper, or only open the chat with the text |
| `/gf minimap on` / `/gf minimap off` | Show or hide the minimap button |
| `/gf blocked` | List the players you blocked |
| `/gf unblock <name>` / `/gf unblock all` | Unblock one player or everyone |
| `/gf diag` | Show the diagnostic summary (for bug reports) |
| `/gf bug` | Open the **Report a problem** window |
| `/gf bug <text>` / `/gf bug list` | Report right away from the chat / list your reports and their state |
| `/gf quests` | Open or close the Quests tab (or click the magnifier next to a quest) |
| `/gf news` | Open **What's New**: one page per version, with the report box on the first page (it also opens by itself on every load until you tick "I've read it" for the current version) |

## Bug reports

Found something wrong or missing? Click the note icon in the window's title bar, the **Report a problem** button in the options, or type `/gf bug`. Write what happened, pick the kind (something broken, wrong text or translation, idea) and press **Send report**.

- The report is saved on your computer and goes to the author automatically, in the background, the next time you are both online on the same realm and faction. You don't need to keep the window open.
- It is only deleted on your side after the author's game has written it to disk, so a crash or a disconnect never loses it. **Your reports** shows the state of each one, and you get a chat message when the author receives it and when it is marked (fixed, won't fix, ...).
- The game only writes saved data to disk when the interface reloads or you log out; the window offers **Save now (/reload)** after you send one.
- By default the report includes the addon version, your settings and the addon's recent events. It never includes other players' names. Untick the box to send only your text.

GrupoFacil also logs its own errors. `/gf diag` shows the summary.

### Another ruleset or faction?

Reports travel as addon whispers, which the game delivers only inside the same ruleset (the author plays on Normal/PvE, Alliance) and possibly not across factions. From PvP, RP or the other faction, use the comments page instead: https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/grupofacil/comments (also linked in the report window, in What's New and with `/gf bug link`).

## Compatibility

- WoW: Forever 1.60.1 (`Interface: 16001`).
- No library dependencies.

## Support

GrupoFacil is free and always will be. If you want to support its development: [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/bsfraga).

## Author and license

Authored by Bael (Bagael Bagacera, Alliance). Released under the [MIT License](https://github.com/bsfraga/GrupoFacil/blob/main/LICENSE).

# Changelog

## 0.14.1
- The ready message of **Recommend to a friend** is shorter and no longer counts clicks.

## 0.14.0
- **Groups for your quests**: a magnifier next to every quest in the objective list (under the minimap) and in the quest details of the quest log. Click it and GrupoFacil searches Looking For Group (Quests & Zones, the quest's zone; a dungeon quest searches the dungeon) and opens the new **Quests** tab.
- The Quests tab lists the zone's groups and players: groups doing that quest first, then groups where someone has it, then the rest of the zone. **Join** asks the leader; **Invite** asks a solo player in.
- Players who also use GrupoFacil tell each other, silently (addon whisper, never a chat channel), which quests they are on. The leader gets your request in the Quests tab and invites with one click.
- **Create group** lists you in Looking For Group for the quest's zone with the same fields as the game's own List button (playstyle: fun and relaxed, which the game requires). Whoever clicks the magnifier on the same quest finds you first, because GrupoFacil players tell each other their quest. A dungeon quest lists a normal dungeon group for that dungeon. If the game refuses or doesn't answer, the addon says so, and keeps the game's error in `/gf diag`. **Remove listing** takes it out.
- Options in the Quests tab: auto-invite players who ask for the same quest (off by default, at most 6 invites every 10 minutes), auto-accept the invite from the leader you asked (on, for 2 minutes after asking), and show or hide the magnifier.
- When the quest is done, the addon offers to leave the group and to remove the listing. It never does either on its own.
- A warning when you get close to the game's limit of about 16 groups joined per hour.
- **Dungeons** and **Quests** are tabs of the same window (in the title bar). `/gf quests` and the magnifier open the Quests tab; opening with Looking For Group always shows Dungeons. A join request that arrives while you are on Dungeons shows as a count on the Quests tab.
- The Quests tab shows the quest's objective, and players who use GrupoFacil see the name, objective and place of the quest your group is listed for (the game doesn't let addons write the listing description).
- The **Find group** button in the quest details and the magnifier in the objective list move out of the way of other addons' buttons (for example Spoken's Play); with no free spot they hide instead of covering anything.
- **What's New** has one page per version, and the first page always has its own box to report bugs, feedback and ideas to the author.
- Nothing is sent while the game restricts chat (instances, encounters). Search, create and remove only run from your click, one per click.
- `/gf debug demo` fills the Quests tab with fake players to try it alone (nothing is sent; `/gf debug demo off` leaves). `/gf debug ping [name]` checks that silent addon messages reach a player.
- After a quest search, the Dungeons tab searches dungeons again (Search again, or switching back to the tab), even when the game's window stays on Quests & Zones.

## 0.13.0
- **Report a problem**: a window to send bugs, wrong texts and ideas straight to the author (note icon in the title bar, the options, or `/gf bug`). Reports wait on your computer and go out by themselves when the author is online; you see the state of each one and get a message when it is received and when it is marked.
- `/gf bug <text>` reports from the chat; `/gf bug list` lists your reports.
- Players on another ruleset (PvP, RP...), and possibly on the other faction, can't reach the author through the game. The report window always shows a link to the comments on CurseForge, and when your reports never reach the author for days it says so in the window and once per session in the chat. `/gf bug link` prints the link.
- Reports work with Forever names (name and surname).
- The report window fits its texts in every language: long labels wrap and push the rest down, report types move to a second line when they don't fit, and your reports keep a piece of what you wrote after they are delivered.
- The note icon in the title bar glows until you open the report window for the first time.
- **What's New**: a window with the changes of the version opens every time the addon loads until you tick "I've read it" at the end of the list. It comes back with the next version. `/gf news` or the options open it any time.
- The list now uses the whole window height the first time it opens.
- `/gf spec` with no talent points says so instead of showing the class name.
- A group member the game fails to describe, or a native search that never answers, no longer logs an error in `/gf diag`.

## 0.12.0
- **Who is this? (/who)** in the right-click menu: opens the chat with `/who "Name Surname"` typed in; press Enter (the game only allows /who from your own chat). The answer shows in the row's tooltip: the player's guild (the Looking For Group data has none) and their exact zone, kept for 30 minutes.
- The dungeon list counts only what the list would show with your current filters.

## 0.11.0
- **Friends and guild first**: your friends (including Battle.net friends playing Forever) and guild members get an icon next to their name and go to the top of the list.
- Players on your game ignore list no longer show up.
- **Right-click a row** to hide it for this session or to block the player. Blocked players stay hidden after a reload.
- **Hidden (N)** button next to Search again: lists everyone you hid or blocked, with **Show** / **Unblock** for each one and **Show all**.
- Unblocking also works in the options (**Unblock all**) or with `/gf unblock <name>` / `/gf unblock all`; `/gf blocked` lists them.

## 0.10.0
- **Needs you**: groups with an open spot for a role you marked in Looking For Group get a green bar and a "needs you" tag.
- The Needs filter uses the open spots the game reports for each group (tank, healer, DPS) instead of guessing from the members.
- Each role filter shows how many results fit it.
- **Dungeon filter**: pick one or more dungeons from the ones in the current results, each with its suggested level.
- **Group tooltip**: every member's role, class and level, the open spots, the leader's zone and the dungeon's level range. A solo player's tooltip shows their zone.
- **Compact mode**: Hide filters folds the filter rows so more of the list fits. The filters keep working and the status line tells you they are on.
- New message variables: `{role}` (your roles in Looking For Group) and `{activity}` (the group's dungeon).

## 0.9.1
- Now also published on Wago Addons (addons.wago.io/addons/grupofacil), so WowUp and the Wago app can install and update it.

## 0.9.0
- New languages: Spanish (Spain), Spanish (Latin America), German and French. The language now follows your game client until you pick one; the options have a language list.
- The window can be resized: drag the corner. More rows fit in a taller window and long names or activities are no longer cut short as soon.
- Role icons instead of T/H/D letters in the list, the tooltips and the role filters.
- Changing the language now asks you to reload with a **Reload now** button, because the game can block add-ons from reloading the interface on their own.

## 0.8.1
- Options: the version line no longer overlaps the language selector.

## 0.8.0
- Quick tour for new users: the first time the window opens, a banner offers a 30-second tour that points at each part of the window (modes, filters, row buttons, Search again, message and options). It never starts on its own.
- One-time chat tip after installing: open Looking For Group or type `/gf`.
- `/gf tour` (or the **Show the tour** button in the options) shows the tour again.

## 0.7.0
- Options button opens the options in the add-on's own window (same content as *Options > AddOns > GrupoFacil*, kept in sync).
- Author credit in the main window and in both options screens.

## 0.12.0
- **Who is this? (/who)** in the right-click menu: opens the chat with `/who "Name Surname"` typed in; press Enter (the game only allows /who from your own chat). The answer shows in the row's tooltip: the player's guild (the Looking For Group data has none) and their exact zone, kept for 30 minutes.
- The dungeon list counts only what the list would show with your current filters.

## 0.11.0
- **Friends and guild first**: your friends (including Battle.net friends playing Forever) and guild members get an icon next to their name and go to the top of the list.
- Players on your game ignore list no longer show up.
- **Right-click a row** to hide it for this session or to block the player. Blocked players stay hidden after a reload.
- **Hidden (N)** button next to Search again: lists everyone you hid or blocked, with **Show** / **Unblock** for each one and **Show all**.
- Unblocking also works in the options (**Unblock all**) or with `/gf unblock <name>` / `/gf unblock all`; `/gf blocked` lists them.

## 0.10.0
- **Needs you**: groups with an open spot for a role you marked in Looking For Group get a green bar and a "needs you" tag.
- The Needs filter uses the open spots the game reports for each group (tank, healer, DPS) instead of guessing from the members.
- Each role filter shows how many results fit it.
- **Dungeon filter**: pick one or more dungeons from the ones in the current results, each with its suggested level.
- **Group tooltip**: every member's role, class and level, the open spots, the leader's zone and the dungeon's level range. A solo player's tooltip shows their zone.
- **Compact mode**: Hide filters folds the filter rows so more of the list fits. The filters keep working and the status line tells you they are on.
- New message variables: `{role}` (your roles in Looking For Group) and `{activity}` (the group's dungeon).

## 0.9.1
- Now also published on Wago Addons (addons.wago.io/addons/grupofacil), so WowUp and the Wago app can install and update it.

## 0.9.0
- New languages: Spanish (Spain), Spanish (Latin America), German and French. The language now follows your game client until you pick one; the options have a language list.
- The window can be resized: drag the corner. More rows fit in a taller window and long names or activities are no longer cut short as soon.
- Role icons instead of T/H/D letters in the list, the tooltips and the role filters.
- Changing the language now asks you to reload with a **Reload now** button, because the game can block add-ons from reloading the interface on their own.

## 0.8.1
- Options: the version line no longer overlaps the language selector.

## 0.8.0
- Quick tour for new users: the first time the window opens, a banner offers a 30-second tour that points at each part of the window (modes, filters, row buttons, Search again, message and options). It never starts on its own.
- One-time chat tip after installing: open Looking For Group or type `/gf`.
- `/gf tour` (or the **Show the tour** button in the options) shows the tour again.

## 0.7.0
- Options button opens the options in the add-on's own window (same content as *Options > AddOns > GrupoFacil*, kept in sync).
- Author credit in the main window and in both options screens.

## 0.6.0
- Minimap button: left-click opens the window, right-click opens the options, drag to move. Can be hidden.

## 0.5.0
- English interface by default, with Brazilian Portuguese available. Switching the language reloads the UI.

## 0.4.1
- Search again waits after any search and explains when the game throttles back-to-back searches.
- The class name sent by the server is no longer shown as a spec.

## 0.4.0
- Options page in *Options > AddOns* and an entry in the AddOns menu.

## 0.3.0
- Join request message in English by default, and customizable.

## 0.2.0
- Built-in diagnostics (`/gf diag`).

## 0.1.0
- First version: level, class and role filters for the Looking For Group list; Invite, Ask to join and Whisper.
